item.title: Cog & Cipher: Mystery of Uncle Oliver
item.description: Platform: itch.io (Game Jam) Genre: Steampunk Adventure, Story-Driven, Puzzle Description: Embark on a captivating journey through a world where gears turn, steam hisses, and secrets lurk in every corner. In Cog & Cipher, you step into the shoes of Clara, a determined young adventurer on a quest to unravel the enigma surrounding her brilliant Uncle Oliver’s disappearance. Key Features: Immersive Steampunk World: Explore a richly detailed universe blending Victorian aesthetics with imaginative machinery and clockwork wonders.
